plots.name: UMAP / t-SNE
plots.description: Dimensionality reduction plots for cell embeddings.

variants.name: Clusters
variants.description: Color cells by cluster or annotation.

variants.name: Feature Expression
variants.description: Map numeric feature expression onto the embedding.

variants.name: Split samples
variants.description: Facet the embedding by sample or condition.

variants.name: Composition pie
variants.description: Show group composition as pies on clusters.

variants.name: Composition ring
variants.description: Embedded ring/pie of sample composition per cluster.

variants.name: Density
variants.description: Filled or hexbin density of cells on the embedding.

variants.name: Highlight cells
variants.description: Emphasize a cell subset; fade the rest.

variants.name: Coexpression
variants.description: Blend two features on the embedding.

variants.name: Lineage
variants.description: Overlay lineage/trajectory paths on the embedding.

variants.name: Mark shapes
variants.description: Encode groups with point shapes as well as color.

variants.name: Stat panel
variants.description: Side statistics panel next to the embedding.

plots.name: Feature embedding
plots.description: Map one or more features onto a 2D embedding.

plots.name: Alluvial
plots.description: Highly customizable multi-stage alluvial / Sankey-flow chart (冲积图): vertical strata bars at each stage with flowing ribbons between them. Ideal for clone tracking, lineage transitions, sample reclassification, and any sequential categorical state (e.g. HX_001 → HX_002 → HX_003). Built with ggsankey for publication-ready SVG/PDF/PNG.

plots.name: Balloon Plot
plots.description: Rewritten, customizable version of the SCA statBalloonplot function. Plots a tile/balloon matrix where each cell is sized by its value, with optional row/column summary statistics on the margins.

plots.name: Classified Bar Plot
plots.description: Classified / categorical bar chart (分类柱状图): one bar per category label, colored by a type/group class. Horizontal by default with full axis, title, legend, grid, and color customization.

plots.name: Cluster Dendrogram Plot
plots.description: Standardized SCA Seuclu2Denplot.R wrapper. Builds per-sample cluster average-expression profiles from an expression matrix + cell metadata, then draws a sample-cluster dendrogram with a group color bar and sample labels via plot.den.cols().

plots.name: Combo Bar + Dot Matrix
plots.description: Combination figure: top bar plot (metric ± error, optional pairwise p-values) with a shared x-axis bottom panel of binary or continuous dots (feature presence / heatmap). Highly customizable horizontal reference line(s) with position, text, color, size, linetype, and label placement — matching method-benchmark panels (AUPRC bars + feature encoding matrix).

plots.name: Combo Bar + Line Plot
plots.description: Dual-axis combination chart: categorical colored bars on the primary Y axis with an optional connected line (and points) on a secondary Y axis. Fully customizable axes, bar/line styles, colors, labels, legend, and export.

plots.name: Den Plot
plots.description: Standardized SCA dendrogram plot wrapper for customizable sample/column clustering trees with annotation color bars.

plots.name: Dot Plot
plots.description: Standardized SCA dot plot wrapper for jjplot2.R (custDotplot / jjDotPlot1). Supports precomputed tidy data frames and aggregate mode from an expression matrix plus annotation, with optional dendrograms.

plots.name: Venn
plots.description: Draw highly customizable Venn and flower Venn diagrams from element-list or abundance-matrix inputs, with subset exports.

plots.name: Expression Statistic Plot
plots.description: Standardized SCA expStatPlot wrapper for highly customizable expression and metadata statistic plots.

plots.name: Feature Density Plot
plots.description: Standardized SCA GsDenPlot.R wrapper that computes KNN-smoothed weighted KDE density of feature expression over a 2D reduction embedding and plots a viridis-colored scatter.

plots.name: GSEA / enrichment running plots
plots.description: Ranked-list enrichment curves, summaries, ridges, and gene-pathway diagrams.

variants.name: Summary
variants.description: Bar/lollipop of NES or signed scores.

variants.name: Running enrichment
variants.description: Classic GSEA running-score tracks for one or more terms.

variants.name: Multi-group overlay
variants.description: Independent ES curves per group for one pathway.

variants.name: Enrichment ridge
variants.description: Density of gene log2FC within each enriched term.

variants.name: Gene-pathway Sankey
variants.description: Alluvial gene-to-term links with enrichment bubbles.

variants.name: Dot summary
variants.description: Bubble/lollipop summary of NES, count, and FDR.

plots.name: Group heatmap
plots.description: Standardized SCA GroupHeatmap wrapper for grouped heatmaps, dotplots, violin heatmaps, annotations, feature groups, and clustered dotplots.

plots.name: GSEA pathway heatmap
plots.description: Combined GSEA running-enrichment figure with per-pathway expression heatmaps. Ranked genes drive the curves and hit tracks; overlapping pathway genes are shown as sample heatmaps.

plots.name: Highlight Effect (Focus + Other Cloud)
plots.description: Horizontal effect / enrichment strip plot that emphasizes a few highlighted categories as large points with error bars (mean ± CI), while packing all non-highlighted terms into a single “Other” lane as a jittered gray point cloud — matching Nature-style focus panels (e.g. key cell types vs other biosamples). Optional significance stars, custom colors, and full axis control.

plots.name: Interactive Arc Network Plot
plots.description: Dense baseline arc network with deterministic geometry, static exports, and Plotly HTML interaction.

plots.name: Interactive Binary Presence/Absence Plot
plots.description: Standards-compliant binary presence/absence dot matrix with static and interactive exports.

plots.name: Interactive Bubble Score Matrix
plots.description: Benchmark matrix with labeled metric bubbles and an independent overall-score panel.

plots.name: Interactive Clustered Heatmap
plots.description: Highly customizable clustered annotated heatmap with static and Plotly outputs.

plots.name: Interactive Correlation Matrix
plots.description: Publication-style customizable triangular correlation matrix with static and Plotly exports.

plots.name: Interactive Dual-Triangle Heatmap
plots.description: Combine independent upper and lower square matrices with separate scales, palettes, legends, annotations, and clustering.

plots.name: Interactive Dumbbell Plot
plots.description: High-customization horizontal Women/Men dumbbell plot with static and Plotly outputs.

plots.name: Enrichment lollipop
plots.description: ChiPlot-style zero-centered lollipop / Cleveland plot. Categories on one axis, signed values on the other, stems to zero, group colors, optional size mapping, full axis/title/legend controls, and optional plotly HTML.

plots.name: Interactive Genomic Signal Track Plot
plots.description: Stacked genomic signal/accessibility tracks with aligned expression distributions and optional genomic features.

plots.name: Interactive Histogram Plot
plots.description: Grouped overlay histogram with shared bins, translucent outlined bars, static exports, and interactive Plotly HTML.

plots.name: Interactive Mantel Correlation Network
plots.description: Triangular correlation matrix with Mantel links and environmental/species point groups.

plots.name: Interactive Motif Enrichment Logo
plots.description: DNA sequence logos from long or grouped wide motif weight matrices with static and interactive outputs.

plots.name: Interactive Network Plot
plots.description: Interactive edge-list and membership/network-Venn graph with static exports.

plots.name: Interactive Pie / Donut Plot
plots.description: Highly customizable pie and donut plot with static ggplot2 and interactive Plotly outputs.

plots.name: Interactive Radar Plot
plots.description: High-customization static and interactive radar/spider chart for multi-group metric profiles.

plots.name: Ridgeline
plots.description: Horizontal distribution clouds with jittered observations and optional box or quantile overlays, exported as static graphics and interactive Plotly HTML.

plots.name: Sankey
plots.description: Highly customizable draggable Sankey flow plot with static vector/raster exports.

plots.name: UpSet
plots.description: Many customizable UpSet plot variants organized as subclasses: basic, intersection size, set size, matrix only, ratio, annotated numeric/categorical, query highlight, grouped, and all intersections.

plots.name: Interactive Violin/Box/Point Plot
plots.description: Highly-customizable vertical violin cloud + box + jitter point distribution plot with static SVG/PDF/PNG and interactive Plotly HTML outputs, supporting wide and long inputs, group faceting or grouped axes, and full layer control.

plots.name: Lineage / trajectory
plots.description: SCA-style lineage/pseudotime trajectory plot. Loess-fitted colored paths with arrows over a 2D embedding, optional whiskers and background stroke.

plots.name: Pie Dot Matrix (Ratio Circles)
plots.description: Matrix of circles where each cell is a pie-filled dot: the filled portion encodes any continuous value (gene ratio, correlation, prevalence, score) in that row category color. Empty cells stay as hollow circles. Optional center marks (star, plus, cross, diamond, text) highlight special hits. Supports column group annotation bands and row background stripes — matching KO / pathway presence–ratio panels common in multi-omics papers.

plots.name: Quadrant Correlation Scatter
plots.description: Draw a highly customizable correlation scatter plot with 4/9 quadrant coloring, threshold lines, selected labels, connector lines, legends, and row selection.

plots.name: Ranked Annotation Panel
plots.description: Draw a ranked numeric point panel with a right-side annotation heatmap panel. Users choose rows, left value column, right annotation columns, continuous/discrete colors, legends, labels, and panel layout.

plots.name: Regression Scatter Plot
plots.description: Multi-group scatter plot with per-group linear or loess regression, confidence interval band, and ChiPlot-style formula / R² / P-value annotations.

plots.name: Volcano
plots.description: Standardized wrapper for SCA VocalnoPlot.R functions (volcanoPlot, avgVolcano, percentVocalno) for marker/differential volcano visualizations.

plots.name: Stacked Bar Plot
plots.description: ChiPlot-style highly customizable stacked (or dodged) composition bar chart. Supports horizontal/vertical orientation, absolute or percent values, group- clustered sample bars, per-category colors, full axis/tick/grid/title/legend styling, and bar text labels.

plots.name: Stat Plot
plots.description: Standardized SCA statPlot wrapper for counts/percentages of categorical metadata levels across groups, with bar/rose/ring/pie/trend/area/dot/sankey/chord/venn/upset plot types.

plots.name: Threshold Matrix Heatmap
plots.description: Draw a highly customizable table-based heatmap with row/column selection, row labels, per-column cutoff coloring rules, tile/circle/shape cells, and editable legend/axis details.

plots.name: Violin Plot
plots.description: Standardized SCA violinPlot.R::classicVlnPlot wrapper for customizable violin plots with optional boxplot/median/dot overlays and annotation strip, operating on long or wide expression tables.
